description: This file contains unit tests for the ArcBufferWriter class within the Orleans.Serialization system. It verifies buffer management, page reference counting, boundary behaviors, exception safety, and interaction with page pooling, ensuring high-performance and safe serialization buffer operations.

classes.name: ArcBufferWriterTests
classes.description: A comprehensive set of unit tests for the ArcBufferWriter class, covering buffer appending, slicing, peeking, consuming, page management, reference counting, safety checks, and edge cases.

methods.name: MultiPageBuffer_CorrectlyHandlesLargeWritesAndRetrieval
methods.description: Tests multi-page buffer writing, slicing, and data integrity.

methods.name: PageBufferManagement_TracksReferenceCountsAndVersions
methods.description: Verifies page reference counting and versioning during slice consumption and release.

methods.name: ReplenishBuffers_ProvidesSegmentsAndFreesPages
methods.description: Simulates socket buffer replenishment, checks page release, and validates data integrity after multiple reads.

methods.name: WriteBuffer_UpdatesLengthCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures buffer length updates after writing data.

methods.name: PeekSlice_ReturnsCorrectDataWithoutConsuming
methods.description: Validates peeking slices without consuming data.

methods.name: ConsumeSlice_ReturnsCorrectDataAndUpdatesLength
methods.description: Checks correct data retrieval and length update after consuming slices.

methods.name: UseAfterFree_ThrowsException
methods.description: Ensures use-after-free on slices causes appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: DoubleFree_ThrowsAndBufferCanBeResetAndDisposed
methods.description: Tests double freeing detection and safe buffer reset/disposal.

methods.name: NewBuffer_IsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies newly created buffer is empty.

methods.name: WriteEmptyBuffer_DoesNotChangeLength
methods.description: Ensures writing empty data does not alter buffer length.

methods.name: PeekEmptyBuffer_ReturnsEmptyAndThrowsOnOverflow
methods.description: Checks peeking into empty buffer and boundary exception.

methods.name: ConsumeEmptyBuffer_ReturnsEmptyAndThrowsOnOverflow
methods.description: Checks consuming empty buffer and boundary exception.

methods.name: DisposeSliceAfterFullPageConsumption_IncrementsPageVersion
methods.description: Validates page versioning after slice disposal at page boundary.

methods.name: PageVersionIncrementAfterWriteAndReadHeadAdvance
methods.description: Ensures page version increment after advancing read head.

methods.name: DisposedBuffer_ThrowsOnAllOperations
methods.description: Confirms that operations on disposed buffer throw ObjectDisposedException.

methods.name: DoubleDisposeArcBuffer_IsSafe
methods.description: Checks idempotency of slice disposal.

methods.name: ResetAfterDispose_Throws
methods.description: Verifies resetting a disposed buffer throws exception.

methods.name: AdvanceWriterNegative_Throws
methods.description: Ensures advancing writer with negative value throws.

methods.name: AdvanceReaderNegativeOrTooLarge_Throws
methods.description: Verifies negative or excessive advance for reader causes exception.

methods.name: ResetReleasesAllPages_EmptiesBuffer
methods.description: Checks that Reset clears buffer and releases pages.

methods.name: DisposeMultipleTimes_IsSafe
methods.description: Ensures multiple disposal calls are safe.

methods.name: WriteAfterDispose_Throws
methods.description: Confirms that writing or accessing memory after dispose throws.

methods.name: PinUnpinReferenceCounting_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies correct pin/unpin behavior and reference count management.

methods.name: UnpinWithInvalidToken_Throws
methods.description: Checks that unpinning with wrong token raises exception.

methods.name: CheckValidityWithInvalidRefCount_Throws
methods.description: Tests that invalid reference counts cause validation exceptions.

methods.name: SliceDispose_DoesNotAffectOriginalBuffer
methods.description: Ensures disposing a slice does not alter the parent buffer.

methods.name: UnsafeSlice_DoesNotPinPages
methods.description: Verifies that unsafe slices do not increment reference count.

methods.name: CopyToWithInsufficientDestination_Throws
methods.description: Ensures copying to undersized span throws exception.

methods.name: ConsumeMoreThanAvailable_Throws
methods.description: Checks that over-consuming throws appropriate exception.

methods.name: SkipAdvancesReadHead_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Validates that skip correctly moves the read head.

methods.name: LargePageReuse_Works
methods.description: Verifies page reuse with larger pages from the pool.

methods.name: MinimumPageReuse_Works
methods.description: Checks page reuse with minimum size pages.

methods.name: BoundaryValue_SlicePeekConsume
methods.description: Tests boundary conditions for slicing, peeking, and consuming.

methods.name: DoubleFree_And_UseAfterFree_Guards
methods.description: Safeguards against double freeing and use-after-free scenarios.

methods.name: NoMemoryLeak_ReferenceCountReturnsToZero
methods.description: Ensures that references are cleaned up and no leaks remain.

methods.name: EmptyAndFullBuffer_SlicePeek
methods.description: Tests behavior for empty and full buffers.

methods.name: SliceAtEnd_ReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Validates slicing at buffer end yields empty slice and boundary exception.

methods.name: MultipleSlices_SamePage_NoLeak
methods.description: Checks that multiple slices to the same page correctly manage reference counts and no leaks.
